headline: Pakistan made a winning start to the IBSF Team World Cup in Oman on Friday, with Muhammad Asif and Asjad Iqbal beating Oman 3-0 and Rana Irfan and Mubashir Raza beating Sweden 3-0, Express Tribune reports.

card.desc: Asif-Asjad ne Oman, Irfan-Mubashir ne Sweden ko haraya

caption:
Snooker Team World Cup mein Pakistan ka shandar aaghaz! 🇵🇰
Express Tribune ke mutabiq Friday ko Oman mein IBSF Team World Cup ke pehle muqablon mein Pakistan ki dono jorion ne 3-0 se jeet hasil ki. Muhammad Asif aur Asjad Iqbal ne Oman ko 72-30, 103-77 aur 89-34 se haraya, jabke Rana Irfan aur Mubashir Raza ne Sweden ko 88-30, 67-27 aur 77-24 se shikast di. Tournament mein 16 teams 4 groups mein hain, aur har group ki top 2 teams knockout stage mein jayengi. Is se pehle Thursday ko Rana Irfan ne final mein Muhammad Asif ko 5-0 se hara kar IBSF World Cup jeeta tha.
Kya Pakistan yeh Team World Cup bhi jeetega? Comment mein batayein 👇
